name: Castmagic
summary: Turns podcasts and recordings into posts, newsletters and articles.
description: Castmagic transcribes an audio or video file, then automatically drafts content from it: summary, show notes, quotes, social posts, newsletter or blog article. You can build your own reusable content templates.
summary_fr: Transforme un podcast ou un enregistrement en posts, newsletters et articles.
description_fr: Castmagic transcrit un fichier audio ou vidéo, puis en tire automatiquement des contenus : résumé, notes d'épisode, citations, posts pour les réseaux, newsletter ou article de blog. On peut créer ses propres modèles de contenus réutilisables.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Paid plans; see the official site for current pricing.

features: Upload audio or podcast episodes for AI transcription.
Generate social posts, newsletters, and blog drafts from transcripts.
Adjust tone and format for each marketing channel.
Export finished content to your publishing stack.
features_fr: Transforme un audio / podcast en posts.
